sections.title: Independent Study
sections.description: MRA students may perform an independent study for credit based on meeting specific educational requirements. All independent study courses require a designated MRA independent study advisor and prior approval from the program director, who will serve as course director for the class. The MRA Independent study course can be performed as an alternative to REG 6400 capstone proposal. The independent study plans must have a learning objective, plan of study and methods of assessment. These elements should be drafted by the student and must be approved by both the designated course director and program staff. The independent study plans are expected to align with the expectations of the capstone proposal writing credit.
